diagram_math_checks.domains_and_maps: alpha:V1→V2 includes x since Tx=0 implies UTx=0. beta:V2→V3 sends x to Tx since UTx=0. gamma:V3→V4 sends y to y+ran T with positive sign. delta:V4→V5 sends y+ran T to Uy+ran(UT); replacing y by y+Tx changes Uy by UTx, so it is well-defined. epsilon:V5→V6 sends z+ran(UT) to z+ran U, well-defined because ran(UT)⊆ran U. These are exactly the formulas in step 1.2; endpoint arrows are zero maps.

diagram_math_checks.relations: Exactness at V1: alpha injective. At V2: ker beta=ker T=im alpha. At V3: y in ker U maps to zero under gamma iff y=Tx, and then UTx=0, giving im beta. At V4: delta([y])=0 iff Uy=UTx, so [y]=[y−Tx] with y−Tx in ker U, giving im gamma. At V5: epsilon([z])=0 iff z in ran U, exactly im delta. At V6: epsilon is surjective because every z+ran U has preimage z+ran(UT). These verify the exactness claimed in steps 2.2–2.3; no commutative squares or extra exact relations are asserted.
